subject: Can we meet Thursday to plan the Q3 launch?
body:
Hi,

Could we schedule a call on Thursday afternoon to plan the Q3 launch? I'd like to walk through the timeline and agree on owners.

Please send me two time slots that work for you by tomorrow.

Thanks,
Maya

subject: Invoice 20418 is overdue
body:
Hello,

Our records show invoice 20418 (amount due: 480.00) is overdue by 12 days. Please confirm payment by Friday or let me know if there is a problem with the invoice.

Accounts Team

subject: Production dashboard is down - urgent
body:
Hi team,

The production dashboard is not working and customers cannot load their reports. Can you look into this immediately? I need you to post an update in the incident channel within the hour.

Daniel
